preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxTxAmount(1) to set the maximum transaction amount to the minimum possible value (1 wei). This will effectively stop all user transactions (except for the owner who is excluded from fee and maxTxAmount checks) by making any transfer amount > 1 fail the require(amount <= _maxTxAmount) check in the _transfer function.
